title: Possible multi-zone disturbance
summary: Crowd density in zone B rose 3.1x within 6 s [SIG-1031], followed by rapid dispersal toward exit C [SIG-1033]. A staff radio report 9 s later mentions people running from platform two [SIG-1034]. No identity recognition was used.
sop: Open camera clips for zones B and C and confirm current crowd flow.
Call back RADIO-1 staff and ask whether Exit C needs temporary metering.
Keep platform announcements calm and route passengers to alternate exits if congestion persists.

vlm.description: Passengers are moving quickly near a gate line while others queue at an exit corridor.

second_opinion.question: Is there a clear benign explanation for the rapid movement?
second_opinion.answer: No; the frame shows fast movement and congestion but no obvious scheduled event signage.

signals.detail: 17 tracks moving above 2.2 m/s toward east gate
exit C occupancy crossed 88% of safe operating threshold

signals.transcript: Control, this is platform two, people are running toward exit C.

signals.detail: automatic snapshot requested after staff radio report
